mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering and then boiling the water was the most worthwhile sequence: it explained why clear water may still contain harmful microbes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and covering the jar felt predictable, although it completed the drinking-water goal.

surprise.text: The washstand pipe carries used water to a separate disposal area; I had initially expected a more general plumbing connection.

arbitrary.text: Burning charcoal for ash was a plausible guess, but its purpose was not clear until the subsequent lye explanation.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the water treatment and soapmaking explanations made the combinations informative, even when the menu made the next action obvious.
